suppress.notes: D-18 (human-approved 2026-09-30): CVE-2025-7962 affects the Angus/Jakarta Mail SMTP implementation (Angus Mail before 2.0.4). angus-activation is the Jakarta Activation implementation, contains no SMTP code and is mis-identified as angus_mail. The shipped SMTP implementation is angus-mail 2.0.5 (fixed). Scoped to angus-activation and this CVE only.
